evidence_notes: CVE-2024-35219 advisory (GHSA-g3hr-p86p-593h) confirms arbitrary file read/delete via outputFolder option
PR #18652 (commit edbb021a) explicitly removes outputFolder usage from the online service
Pre-patch Generator.java lines 121-148 show the full flow: opts.getOptions().get("outputFolder") -> concatenation -> setOutputDir -> ZIP input -> cleanup delete
Patch hunk comments note the input can contain ../../ to access other folders
Single representative case; additional cases with similar output-directory path control in web-exposed code generation services would strengthen coverage
main_issue: Strong single-case evidence with advisory, PR, pre-patch source, and patch hunk all confirming the mechanism. Coverage is limited to one case but the semantic correction from temp-file-race to output-directory path control is well-supported by source evidence. The guideline is coherent across source shape, sink, missing guard, exploit precondition, and safe fix.
mechanism_name: attacker-controlled output directory for generated artifacts
